text: Fine, fine. Take this, and don't tell the Coilkeeper you saw me.

voice.description: A lazy beetle engineer in his thirties caught napping: a thick, slow, mumbling baritone, sleepy and grumpy, becoming flustered and guilty when woken, comic and blue-collar. He speaks English with a soft, neutral accent, close to the microphone in a quiet room, performing a character in a fantasy game.
